children: Alphabet Inc. Class C (NASDAQ:GOOG) reported strong Q2 results and surging Cloud and Gemini usage while raising $84.75B, pursuing chip and GPU partnerships (Marvell, SpaceX) and new AI products (Gemini Enterprise, Kimi K3 talks) amid FTC scrutiny and lofty AI-driven growth forecasts.
Previous Week Recap
GOOG Q2 Revenue Growth
: GOOG Q2 revenue $119.8B, +24% YoY. Google Cloud $24.8B, +82% YoY (~20.7% of sales). Cloud backlog $514B. Capex $44.9B. Gemini >950M monthly users.
Alphabet $84.75B Capital Raise
: Alphabet (GOOG) unveiled an $84.75B capital raise: $18B common stock, $16.75B mandatory convertibles, $10B placement with Berkshire Hathaway, plus an ATM program up to $40B for employee tax needs
GOOG Marvell Chip Deal
: GOOG struck deal with Marvell to co-develop custom chips including TPUs; Google got warrant to buy up to 58.97M Marvell shares at $206.58, potential revenue impact for future years.
TPU-Driven Revenue Outlook
: Morgan Stanley forecasts GOOG TPU-driven revenue up to ~$200B over coming years, modeling ~1M TPUs sold. Expected TPU capacity: 0.3GW H2 2026, 3.2GW 2027, 4.2GW 2028; revenue ~ $84B–$108B.
FTC Probe Final Stages
: FTC probe into Alphabet Class C (GOOG) YouTube account-suspension practices is in final stages; agency weighing lawsuit or settlement, possible court action.
Gemini Enterprise Legal Plugin
: GOOG launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal: a plugin that links to legal software, runs AI agents for routine and complex legal/admin tasks, and adds data security and confidentiality controls.
Moonshot Kimi K3 Talks
: GOOG is in early talks to host Moonshot AI’s open-weight Kimi K3 on Google Cloud. Key trader facts: potential up to 30% revenue share, data access, token-usage auditing; talks ongoing.
BNP Paribas: AI Upside

: BNP Paribas keeps Outperform and $420 target on Alphabet Class C (GOOG), citing AI-driven ad and Google Cloud upside, but flags higher fiscal‑2027 capex and uneven depreciation from new data centers.
Rented GPU Capacity With SpaceX
: Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG) is using rented GPU capacity from SpaceX—part of a multi-party deal providing ~330,000 Nvidia GPUs (~$2.2B/month)—signaling large external AI compute exposure.
Barret Zoph Named VP Research

: GOOG: Barret Zoph named Google VP of Research. He previously spent six years at Google Brain and served as VP of Research at OpenAI. Traders: watch for research-driven product or AI strategy updates.
